mutations.content:
on shoot:
    if shooter is a player:
        if name of shooter's tool is "&cTNT Bow":
            set metadata "is_tnt_arrow" of projectile to "true"

on projectile hit:
    if metadata "is_tnt_arrow" of projectile is "true":
        set {_loc} to location of projectile
        loop 20 times:
            wait 2 ticks
            spawn 5 primed tnt at {_loc}
            loop last spawned tnt:
                set velocity of loop-value to vector(random number between -0.5 and 0.5, 0.5, random number between -0.5 and 0.5)
        delete projectile

command /give-tnt-bow:
    permission: op
    trigger:
        give player a bow named "&cTNT Bow" with lore "&7Shoots cascading TNT explosions."
